inferno_lord_vulgrim.name: Inferno-Lord Vulgrim
inferno_lord_vulgrim.combat_profile: Cataclysmic fire attacks, boiling magma surges, and heat auras that melt frontline armor over time.

mirl_mother_morvana.name: Mirl-Mother Morvana
mirl_mother_morvana.combat_profile: Controls toxic bog tentacles and ancient curses while spawning waves of lesser marsh fiends.

xylos_weaver_of_rot.name: Xylos the Weaver of Rot
xylos_weaver_of_rot.combat_profile: Traps targets in necrotic web-spans, drains life through localized web-zones, and inflicts compounding decay.

golgotha_soul_tainted.name: Golgotha the Soul-Tainted
golgotha_soul_tainted.combat_profile: Wields spectral slashes and a soul-harvesting aura that raises fallen combatants as temporary phantom thralls.

ignis_rex.name: Ignis Rex
ignis_rex.combat_profile: Uses sweeping tail attacks, armored scale deflections, and high-intensity localized flame breath barrages.

hero_selection.rule: Any hero present in the player's unlocked_heroes list may be selected for a territory board unless a future scenario explicitly restricts the roster.

vesper_chestplate.name: Frostbinder Chestplate
vesper_chestplate.description: Vesper's crystalline chest armor. Acquiring this relic unlocks Vesper, The Frostbinder, for the player's hero roster.

player_progression.hero_unlock_rule: A hero becomes selectable when the player owns the collectible referenced by that hero's unlock_item field.
